question: Past chaos, does the logistic map ever find order again?
answer: Past about 3.57 the logistic map is chaotic, but not everywhere. At R = 3.83 it locks into a stable 3-year cycle, which then splits into 6, 12, 24 before chaos returns. Islands like this hide cycles of every length.
move: Chaos has windows of order: the right R gives a stable cycle.

web.label: An interactive diagram of the logistic map, a chaotic sea with calm islands labeled by their cycle period. Tap to pick an R and race it against R = 3.83. Asks whether the map ever finds order again past chaos.

source: Veritasium, “This equation will change how you see the world (the logistic map)” (YouTube, 2020)
